name: Economy log records a destroyed rare item once the character saves
contract: With the economy log on, a player who destroys an item of rare quality or better gets one item_destroy row in coa_economy_log with that item, written when the character is saved. Destroying a common item writes nothing. Destroying a vanity item writes the row whatever its quality: Arclight Spanner (6219, common) is in this server's VanityCollection.dbc. A destroyed item that item recovery archives is saved at once, and that save writes its row.

steps.label: the destroy's own save wrote the row, nothing waits
one item_destroy row for the sword
no row for the common cloth
one item_destroy row for the vanity spanner
